title: Microsoft Edge: choose a profile at startup with a profile picker
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, policy behaviour, Group Policy paths and registry settings are supported. The Windows configuration guide confirms the Computer Configuration steps flagged by the pre-check; whether the picker appears at startup by default and its feature-specific licensing remain unstated.

claims.claim: ProfilePickerAvailability controls whether users can open the profile picker, including its startup behaviour.
claims.quote: This policy controls whether users can open the profile picker in Microsoft Edge. The profile picker lets users choose a profile to open and manage their profiles.

claims.claim: Setting ProfilePickerAvailability to false makes the picker unavailable.
claims.quote: If you set this policy to false, the profile picker isn't available.

claims.claim: Setting ProfilePickerAvailability to false hides the picker entry from the profile menu.
claims.quote: The entry for opening the profile picker is hidden from the profile menu

claims.where: controls[0].note; What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls
claims.claim: Setting ProfilePickerAvailability to false skips the startup picker and follows normal browser startup behaviour.
claims.quote: the browser skips the profile picker at startup and follows its normal browser startup behavior.
